title: Mermaid
description: Top-level schema for a Mermaid diagram document. It gathers the cross-cutting nodes (config, directives) and one optional node per diagram type (flowchart first; swimlane, gantt, and the rest follow as sibling nodes). Every node is optional. Breadcrumbs for the config node: the official config schema is https://mermaid.js.org/schemas/config.schema.json and its API docs are https://mermaid.js.org/config/schema-docs/config.html . The local `mermaidConfig-schema.json` is a copy of that official schema with every `required` array removed, because the official `required` describes the fully-resolved runtime config, not a partial author config.

config.description: Optional. The Mermaid configuration object (local copy of the official schema, with `required` removed).

flowchart.description: Optional. The flowchart diagram body. One of several diagram bodies; more are added as sibling nodes.
